rawActions.summary: Change ref add to positional args: ref add <name> [summary]. Silent existence probe on <name> relative to world root — if file found, auto-set source=nf:./<name>; multiple matches do nothing. --source <uri> explicit override, stored as-is. --relevance <n> defaults to 0.5. Mirrors task add pattern.
